title: Spyglass Officially Launched
summary: We are thrilled to announce that Spyglass has officially launched, delivering its powerful capabilities for everyone to enjoy.

title: Complete File Control in Your Editor
summary: Take complete command of your documents and media with our new file management features, empowering you to easily add, organize, and display your content exactly as you envision.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Discover our new public roadmap, where you can easily explore recently completed features, see what's coming next, and get a glimpse into our exciting future plans.

title: Improved Checkbox Experience
summary: We've significantly upgraded our checkboxes to be more intuitive, visually appealing, and effortless to use, making it easier than ever to manage your tasks and projects.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Enjoy a smoother, more intuitive collaborative editing experience that keeps everyone perfectly in sync and aware of real-time changes.

title: Enhanced Collaboration & Shared Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on all content shared with you, making teamwork more seamless and ensuring valuable insights are always within reach.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to announce Noeko's codebase is now fully open source, empowering our community with maximum control, transparency, and a direct voice in its exciting future.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Language
summary: Connect with Noeko more seamlessly than ever before, as we roll out robust international language support to welcome users worldwide.

title: Enhanced & Expanded Theme Collection
summary: We are revamping our current themes for a stunning visual experience and introducing a vibrant array of new options to personalize your workspace.

title: Unlocking Your Knowledge Graph's Potential
summary: Explore your entire knowledge base and discover new connections with advanced filtering and seamless collaboration tools, transforming your graph view into a powerful hub for insights and shared understanding.

title: Discover & Organize with Advanced Search and Custom Collections
summary: Uncover precisely what you need faster with advanced filtering options, and save your custom search views as personalized collections for instant access to your most relevant information.

title: Dynamic Note Previews
summary: Experience a more intuitive and visually rich way to connect your ideas, with flexible new options for displaying linked information directly within your notes.

title: Unlocking Noeko: Self-Hosting & Flexible Plans
summary: Soon you'll be able to host Noeko on your own infrastructure for ultimate control, or scale effortlessly with our new flexible cloud-hosted premium plans.

title: Smarter, Personalized Greetings
summary: We're ensuring our greetings on the homepage always reflect the correct time of day, delivering a more personalized and precise welcome every time you log in.

title: Streamlined Actions for Tagged Items
summary: You can now effortlessly manage and refine your tagged content with direct actions available right within your tag lists, saving valuable time.

title: Unlock More Ways to Learn
summary: Seamlessly integrate a wider variety of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to enrich your knowledge base and streamline your learning experience.
